issues.description: Recurring streetlight flicker along the Overpass approach, reported by three separate crews, never reproduced during a scheduled inspection.
issues.notes: Most likely a load-timing artifact from foot traffic crossing at shift change. Not yet assigned -- no evidence it connects to anything else, and no crew has been able to reproduce it to work from.

issues.description: East Canal Pumphouse pressure drops every time Founders' Plaza Fountain runs its evening cycle, and the two systems have no documented connection.
issues.notes: Candidate for a systemic pattern (undocumented shared-resource contention) but no affinity chain has been documented yet -- flagged by the validator as WARN_AFFINITY_UNRESOLVED until someone traces further instances. Logged by Building Inspector once traced; assigned to Public Works to resolve, since it's within their own correctionPermissions.

issues.description: Structural engineers confirm the Overpass is load-bearing for Transit Hub Terminal Three's east entrance, despite no permit ever authorizing that connection.
issues.notes: Confirmed systemic: this isn't a one-off, it's a load-bearing dependency that was never formally recognized. Any correction targeting rel-overpass-supports-transit triggers WARN_SYSTEMIC_CASCADE and requires explicit human sign-off before proceeding -- assigned to City Council (via the Mayor) since Building Inspector doesn't have standing to authorize the fix itself.
